is_operating_company.description: true for a company that sells a product or service; false for a fund, nonprofit, government body or investment vehicle; null if unclear

is_own_funding_round.description: true if the news is the company raising money for itself (equity, a venture round, a seed or growth round); false if it is a fund the company manages, debt for lending, an acquisition or an IPO; null if unclear

hq_city.description: City of the headquarters, as the sources state it; null if not found

nyc_office.description: yes: headquarters, an office or a team in New York City (the five boroughs); no: sources show it is based elsewhere with no NYC office; unknown: not found

evidence.description: One short line quoting or describing what shows the answer; null if unknown

source_url.description: URL of the page that shows it; null if unknown
